product.title: Cultural Immersion Experience by Bike around old BA Max 6 ppl

description.text: In Buenos Aires, this small-group bike outing covers Plaza de Mayo, La Boca, Puerto Madero, and San Telmo, with mate, alfajores, and a local sandwich listed. Bikes, helmets, and water are included; the meeting point is a parking garage on Avenida Hipolito Yrigoyen near Plaza de Mayo. The published duration is about five hours, and the group is capped. The format suits visitors who want a guided cultural bike day without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Buenos Aires, and the itinerary stays on those four historic-south stops that define this outing rather than a Tigre kayak add-on or a Recoleta cemetery walk.

highlights: Discover the South of Buenos Aires on this small-group bike tour
Lose yourself in the historic atmosphere of the Plaza de Mayo, the colorful streets of La Boca, the stylish modern feel
Visit some of the city’s loveliest green areas, and enjoy mate, alfajores, and a tasty sandwich from a local food truck
